sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Milcom, along with Ashtoreth and Chemosh, was left by the Queen of Sheba to guard the Golden Asp, the entrance to King Solomon's mines, the resting place of the Legendary Titan of Spirit, Tao. The three Titans lay dormant in the form of statues for many years. [The Golden Asp]

The three Colossi were awoken after Cherit pressed the eye of the Golden Asp which had been found by Dante Vale, Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill. [The Golden Asp]

After the Organization arrived, the Professor hypnotized the Colossi using his Ring of Araknos, sending the guardians to attack ​Dante Vale and his team. After punching Lindorm, Milcom was tripped over Caliban and stunned by Lok, Sophie, Icarus and Venadek. He was then defeated by Caliban and Venadek together. [To Be Together]

Milcom's "Colossal Stride" ability allows him to run at great speed and cover great distance, despite his bulky size. {{source|To Be Together}} He also has the distinction of being the strongest, offensively, of the three colossi.

full_text:
Milcom the Colossus is one of the three massive Colossi set up by the Queen of Sheba to guard King Solomon's mines against invaders.

== History ==
Milcom, along with Ashtoreth and Chemosh, was left by the Queen of Sheba to guard the Golden Asp, the entrance to King Solomon's mines, the resting place of the Legendary Titan of Spirit, Tao. The three Titans lay dormant in the form of statues for many years. [The Golden Asp]

The three Colossi were awoken after Cherit pressed the eye of the Golden Asp which had been found by Dante Vale, Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill. [The Golden Asp]

After the Organization arrived, the Professor hypnotized the Colossi using his Ring of Araknos, sending the guardians to attack ​Dante Vale and his team. After punching Lindorm, Milcom was tripped over Caliban and stunned by Lok, Sophie, Icarus and Venadek. He was then defeated by Caliban and Venadek together. [To Be Together]

== Abilities ==
Milcom is strong and powerful, able to wield a large staff to knock back his enemies. Milcom's "Colossal Stride" ability allows him to run at great speed and cover great distance, despite his bulky size. [To Be Together] He also has the distinction of being the strongest, offensively, of the three colossi.
